Copper & brass machining
Copper & brass parts, made to specification

Machined fittings, electrical contacts and custom connectors in copper and brass alloys.

Prepare RFQ email
Turned brass & copper components
Conductive parts and threaded fittings

Electrical contacts and fluid fittings need different acceptance criteria. Choose the alloy for the function and specify any required testing; the examples do not establish electrical or fluid-system qualification.

Geometry & process
For conductive parts, heat-transfer components, manifolds and threaded fittings. Turning, milling, 5-axis work and casting finishing cover cylindrical fittings and complex conductive parts.
Size & workholding
Send a 3D model with the overall dimensions and stock size. Show mating areas and fastening details so tool access and clamping space can be reviewed around contact areas, passages and threads.
Material & finish
C36000 brass and tellurium copper are named options in the copper and brass service. Burr control matters around threads and passages. Specify polishing or plating requirements and any surfaces that need direct electrical contact.
Grades to discuss

Copper: C11000 · C10200 · C12000

Brass: C26000 · C36000

Copper and brass are separate material families. State the required grade and electrical, thermal, surface or fit requirements in your inquiry.

Separate electrical function from mechanical fit
Machining in practice
All machining studies
Custom metal parts in batches: shafts, fittings and housings

Turned shafts, fittings and recessed housings: a selection of custom metal components in batches.

More photographs from the workshop
Drawing & acceptance
Drawing requirements

Specify alloy and material restrictions. Distinguish electrical contact areas from sealing faces, threads and cosmetic surfaces.

For contacts, show mating area and fastening details. For fittings, state thread standard, seal arrangement and the intended fluid environment.

Inspection and acceptance

Define thread gauging, burr acceptance and contact or seal surface requirements. State which dimensions apply after any plating.

Specify conductivity, pressure or other functional tests separately, with acceptance criteria. Agree the tests to include in the quotation.

Agree the measurement method and required records before production.

Quality & inspection
Equipment and order records
Prepare your copper & brass machining enquiry

Include alloy designation, finish or plating specification, quantities and assembly information.

State the applicable material restrictions and declarations you need. Confirm that the declarations are available for the proposed supply.

Prepare RFQ email

Add your requirements to the email draft, then attach drawings in your email app before sending.
